metadata.purpose: supplementary non-trading study of two untested turning markers
metadata.outcome_clock: event known at signal close; outcome starts at next open and ends at the close N trading days after the signal
metadata.matching: up to three nearest same-date, other-symbol controls in the same causal setup state but without the defining doji/volume event
limitations: This is a locked retrospective supplement on previously inspected data, not a pristine untouched holdout.
The causal deep-decline definition is not proof that the event bar is a market bottom.
Multiple predeclared variants are reported without selecting a winner; isolated significance is insufficient for launch.
Point-in-time cohorts reduce but do not eliminate index-selection and survivorship bias.
Matched controls reduce broad market and state confounding but do not prove causality.
Historical conditional frequencies cannot guarantee future behavior.

quiet_doji_pullback.doji: abs(Close - Open) / (High - Low) <= 0.20; zero-range bars excluded
quiet_doji_pullback.isolated_control: same quiet pullback state without a doji
quiet_doji_pullback.combined_control: same MA/pullback state without the full quiet-doji event

deep_decline_huge_volume.depressed_state: at least 10 of prior 20 closes below MA20 and current Close <= MA20
deep_decline_huge_volume.long_lower_shadow: lower shadow / range >= 0.45 and close location >= 0.55
deep_decline_huge_volume.reclaim_fast: within 5 bars after deep state, prior Close <= prior active fast MA, then bullish Close > active fast MA with close location >= 0.65; active fast MA is MA5 in short mode and MA20 in mid mode
